question: Approve the ideation of seed-check-requires-schema-fields to enter implementation? FO recommends approve; approving accepts that recommendation narrowed: the README makes a stored id optional under id-style: slug (Spacedock omits it; 162 of 163 tasks lack it), the seed check requires Non-goals, Budget and Stop condition, and it applies to new seeds only, with the replay counts reported instead of enforced on existing tasks.

artifacts.summary: Replay of the design as first written: 141 of 164 tasks newly refused, all seven of this batch's own seeds among them; pr_watch.py seeds() would also flag up to 53 current backlog tasks. Worse under the narrowing: three more lines per new seed, with no recorded harm from a missing budget yet; the other choice is to drop those lines from the README. Chief-engineer reviewed the whole batch (2026-10-27) and recommends this disposition.
